theorem boundaryCost_congr (as : List PositiveMass) {q r q' r' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ j, j+1 < as.length → q j = q' j) (hr : ∀ j, j+1 < as.length → r j = r' j) :
    boundaryCost as q r = boundaryCost as q' r' := by
  induction as generalizing q r q' r' with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases as with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b as =>
      simp only [boundaryCost]
      rw [hq 0 (by simp),hr 0 (by simp)]
      congr 1
      apply ih
      · intro j hj
        exact hq (j+1) (by simpa only [List.length_cons] using Nat.add_lt_add_right hj 1)
      · intro j hj
        exact hr (j+1) (by simpa only [List.length_cons] using Nat.add_lt_add_right hj 1)

theorem rootBoundaryCost_congr (as : List PositiveMass) {q r q' r' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ j, j < as.length → q j = q' j) (hr : ∀ j, j < as.length → r j = r' j) :
    rootBoundaryCost as q r = rootBoundaryCost as q' r' := by
  cases as with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as =>
    simp only [rootBoundaryCost]
    rw [hq 0 (by simp),hr 0 (by simp)]
    congr 1
    exact boundaryCost_congr (a::as) (fun j hj => hq (j+1) hj) (fun j hj => hr (j+1) hj)

theorem rootBoundaryCost_uniform {as : List PositiveMass} {q r : ℕ → ℝ} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ho : as.Pairwise (fun a b => a.val ≤ b.val))
    (hu : ∀ a ∈ as, a.val ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ j, j ≤ as.length → |q j-r j| ≤ M) :
    rootBoundaryCost as q r ≤ M := by
  cases as with
  | nil => exact hM
  | cons a as =>
    have hb := boundaryCost_le hM ho hu (q := fun j => q (j+1)) (r := fun j => r (j+1))
      (fun j hj => hm (j+1) (by omega))
    have h0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm 0 (by simp)) a.property.le
    change a.val*|q 0-r 0|+_ ≤ M

variable {S : Type*} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S] {n : ℕ}

 theorem markedAttach_preserves {w : S → ℝ} (hw : ∀ σ, 0 < w σ)
    (φ : S → (Fin (n+1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) {as : List PositiveMass}
    (T : ClockTree S as) {a : ℝ} (ho : MassOrdered a as)
    (p : MarkedPlacement T) (hp : p ∈ T.markedAttach a)
    (q : ℕ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0) (P : T.Assignment → ℝ) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    p.tree.expect w φ q (fun σ => P (p.restrict σ)) x = T.expect w φ q P x := by
  have hm : p.realize q ∈ (T.realize q).markedAttach a := by
    rw [← T.markedAttach_realize a q]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
  have h := (T.realize q).markedAttach_preserves hw φ (clockSteps_ordered ho q)
    (p.realize q) hm (fun σ => P ((T.assignmentEquiv q).symm σ)) x
  rw [p.tree.expect_realize,T.expect_realize]
  simpa only [MarkedPlacement.realize,Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

    (φ : S → (Fin (n+1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) {as : List PositiveMass}
    (T : ClockTree S as) {a : ℝ} (ho : MassOrdered a as)
    (P : T.Assignment → ℝ) (q₀ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (q : ℕ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => T.expect w φ (fun j i => Real.toNNReal (q j i)) P (x+y))
      (Measure.pi fun i => gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (q₀ i))) := by
  have h := ((T.homTest P).eval_smooth hw φ ho q 0).integrable_zero_shift
    (ν := Measure.pi fun i => gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (q₀ i))) x
  simpa only [ClockTree.eval_homTest] using h

    (φ : S → (Fin (n+1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) {as : List PositiveMass}
    (T : ClockTree S as) {a : ℝ} (ho : MassOrdered a as)
    {P Q : T.Assignment → ℝ} (hPQ : ∀ σ, P σ ≤ Q σ)
    (q₀ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (q : ℕ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    T.rootExpect w φ P q₀ q x ≤ T.rootExpect w φ Q q₀ q x := by
  rw [T.rootExpect_eq_integral,T.rootExpect_eq_integral]
  apply integral_mono (T.rootExpect_integrable hw φ ho P q₀ q x)

# MODULE: qsa_block_select
Block-score top-k selection for quantized sparse attention: per-block cell weights, the 8-bit radix digit scan,
and the equal-key budget clamp.

## Source semantics
Blocks 0..n_bid cover n_kv cells in groups of R; the last block (index n_bid = n_kv / R) may be partial.
The radix select scans a histogram from digit 255 downward and stops at the first digit whose cumulative
count reaches `width`. Ties at the threshold are taken lowest-index first within a per-thread budget.

## Form template identifiers
- `R` ↔ `R` (indexer block size, 4); `nKv` ↔ `n_kv`; `nBid` ↔ `n_bid`; `width` ↔ `width`
- `hist` ↔ `hist[256]`; `scan` ↔ the digit loop in `block_topk_kernel`
-/

namespace Strata.QsaBlockSelect

-- § block weights

/-- Weight (cell count) of block `b`: `R` for full blocks, the remainder for the last one. -/
def blockWeight (R nKv nBid b : Nat) : Nat := if b < nBid then R else nKv - nBid * R

/-- Total weight of blocks `0..n-1`. -/
def totalWeight (R nKv nBid : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => totalWeight R nKv nBid n + blockWeight R nKv nBid n

/-- Blocks strictly below `n_bid` each carry exactly `R` cells. -/
theorem totalWeight_below (R nKv nBid : Nat) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ nBid → totalWeight R nKv nBid n = n * R := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _; simp [totalWeight]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro h
    have hk : k < nBid := by omega
    have h1 := ih (by omega)
    have h2 : blockWeight R nKv nBid k = R := by simp [blockWeight, hk]
    simp only [totalWeight, h1, h2]
    rw [Nat.succ_mul]

/-- The `n_bid + 1` blocks together cover exactly `n_kv` cells when `n_bid = n_kv / R`. -/
theorem total_covers_kv (R nKv : Nat) (hR : 0 < R) :
    totalWeight R nKv (nKv / R) (nKv / R + 1) = nKv := by
  have h1 := totalWeight_below R nKv (nKv / R) (nKv / R) (Nat.le_refl _)
  have h2 : (nKv / R) * R ≤ nKv := Nat.div_mul_le_self nKv R
  have h3 : blockWeight R nKv (nKv / R) (nKv / R) = nKv - (nKv / R) * R := by
    simp [blockWeight]
  simp only [totalWeight, h1, h3]
  generalize (nKv / R) * R = m at *
  omega

/-- The last block weight is strictly less than `R` (it is the remainder `n_kv % R`). -/
theorem last_weight_lt (R nKv : Nat) (hR : 0 < R) :
    blockWeight R nKv (nKv / R) (nKv / R) < R := by
  have h3 : blockWeight R nKv (nKv / R) (nKv / R) = nKv - (nKv / R) * R := by
    simp [blockWeight]
  have h4 : nKv % R < R := Nat.mod_lt _ hR
  have h5 : nKv = R * (nKv / R) + nKv % R := (Nat.div_add_mod nKv R).symm
  rw [h3]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm] at h5
  generalize (nKv / R) * R = m at *
  omega

-- § radix digit scan

/-- Scan histogram digits from `k` down to 1; stop at the first digit reaching `width`, else digit 0. -/
def scan (hist : Nat → Nat) (width : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0, cum => (0, cum)
  | k + 1, cum =>
    if width ≤ cum + hist (k + 1) then (k + 1, cum)
    else scan hist width k (cum + hist (k + 1))

/-- The scan never returns a digit above its starting digit. -/
theorem scan_digit_le (hist : Nat → Nat) (width : Nat) :
    ∀ k cum, (scan hist width k cum).1 ≤ k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro cum; simp [scan]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro cum
    unfold scan
    split
    · exact Nat.le_refl _
    · have := ih (cum + hist (k + 1)); omega

/-- The cumulative count above the chosen digit only grows. -/
theorem scan_above_ge (hist : Nat → Nat) (width : Nat) :
    ∀ k cum, cum ≤ (scan hist width k cum).2 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro cum; simp [scan]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro cum
    unfold scan
    split
    · exact Nat.le_refl _
    · have := ih (cum + hist (k + 1)); omega

/-- A nonzero chosen digit reaches the width: `above + hist[d] ≥ width`. -/
theorem scan_reaches (hist : Nat → Nat) (width : Nat) :
    ∀ k cum, 0 < (scan hist width k cum).1 →
      width ≤ (scan hist width k cum).2 + hist (scan hist width k cum).1 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro cum h; simp [scan] at h
  | succ k ih =>
    intro cum h
    unfold scan at h ⊢
    split at h
    · rename_i hw
      simp only [hw, if_true]
      exact hw
    · rename_i hw
      simp only [hw, if_false]
      exact ih _ h

-- § equal-key budget

/-- Per-thread share of equal-key cells: the budget left after earlier threads, clamped into `[0, eq]`. -/
def myEq (budget before eq : Nat) : Nat := min eq (budget - before)

/-- A thread never selects more equal-key cells than it owns. -/
theorem myEq_le (budget before eq : Nat) : myEq budget before eq ≤ eq := by
  unfold myEq; omega

/-- A thread past the budget selects no equal-key cells. -/
theorem myEq_zero (budget before eq : Nat) (h : budget ≤ before) : myEq budget before eq = 0 := by
  unfold myEq; omega

/-- A thread fully inside the budget selects all of its equal-key cells. -/
theorem myEq_full (budget before eq : Nat) (h : before + eq ≤ budget) : myEq budget before eq = eq := by
  unfold myEq; omega

end Strata.QsaBlockSelect

and shared-memory / thread-count geometry of the launcher.

ids = stable argsort(-p)[:k]; w = gather(p, ids); s = max(sum w, 2^-14); out = w / s.

`ov > bv || (ov == bv && oi < bi)`. The taken-mask is first in shared memory (16-byte padded).

- `better` ↔ the merge predicate; `takenBytes` ↔ `taken_bytes`; `launchThreads` ↔ `threads`
- `clampDen` ↔ `fmax(s, 2^-14)`
-/

namespace Strata.MoeRouterTop10

-- § the selection order

/-- Candidate `(v, i)` beats `(v', i')`: larger value, or equal value and smaller index. -/
def better (a b : Nat × Nat) : Prop := a.1 > b.1 ∨ (a.1 = b.1 ∧ a.2 < b.2)

/-- `better` is irreflexive. -/
theorem better_irrefl (a : Nat × Nat) : ¬ better a a := by
  unfold better; omega

/-- `better` is transitive. -/
theorem better_trans (a b c : Nat × Nat) (h1 : better a b) (h2 : better b c) : better a c := by
  unfold better at *; omega

/-- Distinct-index candidates are always comparable: the order is total, so the argmax is unique. -/
theorem better_total (a b : Nat × Nat) (h : a.2 ≠ b.2) : better a b ∨ better b a := by
  unfold better; omega

/-- On equal values the smaller index wins. -/
theorem better_tie (v i j : Nat) (h : i < j) : better (v, i) (v, j) := by
  unfold better; omega

/-- A merge step keeps `a` iff it is not beaten by `b`; merging is symmetric on distinct indices. -/

/-- The merge result is never beaten by either input (distinct indices). -/

    ¬ better b (merge a b) ∧ ¬ better a (merge a b) := by
  unfold merge better
  split <;> rename_i hh <;> simp only [better] at hh <;> omega

/-- Clamped denominator, in units of 2^-14 (so the lower bound is 1). -/

/-- The renormalization denominator is never zero. -/

/-- The clamp does not change denominators that are already large enough. -/

  unfold clampDen; omega

/-- The padding adds fewer than 16 bytes. -/

theorem smem_double_aligned (n : Nat) : takenBytes n % 16 = 0 := takenBytes_aligned n

  unfold launchThreads; omega

  unfold windowLen; omega

  unfold cutKeep; split <;> omega

# MODULE: shared_expert_combine
Scratch carving and alignment for the shared expert, the per-token scalar gate scaling, and the MoE
combination (router-weighted routed parts plus a plain shared term).

## Source semantics
shared = silu(gate_proj x) * up_proj x, down-projected, scaled by one scalar gate per token. The MoE block
output is `sum_e w_e * part_e + shared` with the shared output added PLAIN (not router-weighted).
Scratch layout: gate | up | q8_0 | q8k | g, each 16-byte aligned.

## Form template identifiers
- `align16` ↔ `(x + 15) & ~15`; `scratchBytes` ↔ `shared_expert_scratch_bytes`
- `combine` ↔ `moe_combine_kernel`; `scaleRow` ↔ `out[i] *= g`
-/

namespace Strata.SharedExpertCombine

-- § alignment and scratch

/-- Round up to a multiple of 16. -/
def align16 (n : Nat) : Nat := (n + 15) / 16 * 16

/-- Alignment never shrinks. -/
theorem align16_ge (n : Nat) : n ≤ align16 n := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Result is a multiple of 16. -/
theorem align16_mod (n : Nat) : align16 n % 16 = 0 := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Alignment adds fewer than 16 bytes. -/
theorem align16_lt (n : Nat) : align16 n < n + 16 := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Alignment is idempotent. -/
theorem align16_idem (n : Nat) : align16 (align16 n) = align16 n := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Total scratch bytes for a given `n_ff`. -/
def scratchBytes (nFf : Nat) : Nat :=
  align16 (nFf * 4) * 2 + align16 (nFf / 32 * 34) + align16 (nFf / 256 * 292) + 32

/-- Offsets of the carved regions, in order: gate, up, q8_0, q8k, g. -/
def offsets (nFf : Nat) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  let a := align16 (nFf * 4)
  let q0 := align16 (nFf / 32 * 34)
  let qk := align16 (nFf / 256 * 292)
  (0, a, a * 2, a * 2 + q0, a * 2 + q0 + qk)

/-- Every region offset is 16-byte aligned. -/
theorem offsets_aligned (nFf : Nat) :
    (offsets nFf).2.1 % 16 = 0 ∧ (offsets nFf).2.2.1 % 16 = 0 ∧
    (offsets nFf).2.2.2.1 % 16 = 0 ∧ (offsets nFf).2.2.2.2 % 16 = 0 := by
  unfold offsets
  have h1 := align16_mod (nFf * 4)
  have h2 := align16_mod (nFf / 32 * 34)
  have h3 := align16_mod (nFf / 256 * 292)
  simp only
  omega

/-- The scalar gate slot ends inside the scratch buffer (room for 32 bytes after the q8k region). -/
theorem gate_slot_fits (nFf : Nat) : (offsets nFf).2.2.2.2 + 4 ≤ scratchBytes nFf := by
  unfold offsets scratchBytes
  simp only
  omega

/-- Region ordering: gate < up < q8_0 offset when `n_ff > 0`. -/
theorem offsets_ordered (nFf : Nat) (h : 0 < nFf) :
    (offsets nFf).2.1 < (offsets nFf).2.2.1 := by
  unfold offsets
  have h1 := align16_ge (nFf * 4)
  simp only
  omega

  simp [combine]

    combine ws ps (some s) = weightedSum ws ps + s := by
  simp [combine]

  simp only [combine]; omega

  simp [weightedSum]

    cases ps with

shared = silu(gate_proj x) * up_proj x, down-projected, scaled by one scalar gate per token. The MoE block
output is `sum_e w_e * part_e + shared` with the shared output added PLAIN (not router-weighted).

- `align16` ↔ `(x + 15) & ~15`; `scratchBytes` ↔ `shared_expert_scratch_bytes`
- `combine` ↔ `moe_combine_kernel`; `scaleRow` ↔ `out[i] *= g`
-/

/-- Round up to a multiple of 16. -/
def align16 (n : Nat) : Nat := (n + 15) / 16 * 16

/-- Alignment never shrinks. -/
theorem align16_ge (n : Nat) : n ≤ align16 n := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Result is a multiple of 16. -/
theorem align16_mod (n : Nat) : align16 n % 16 = 0 := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Alignment adds fewer than 16 bytes. -/
theorem align16_lt (n : Nat) : align16 n < n + 16 := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Alignment is idempotent. -/
theorem align16_idem (n : Nat) : align16 (align16 n) = align16 n := by
  unfold align16; omega

/-- Total scratch bytes for a given `n_ff`. -/
def scratchBytes (nFf : Nat) : Nat :=
  align16 (nFf * 4) * 2 + align16 (nFf / 32 * 34) + align16 (nFf / 256 * 292) + 32

  let a := align16 (nFf * 4)
  let q0 := align16 (nFf / 32 * 34)
  let qk := align16 (nFf / 256 * 292)
  (0, a, a * 2, a * 2 + q0, a * 2 + q0 + qk)

    (offsets nFf).2.1 % 16 = 0 ∧ (offsets nFf).2.2.1 % 16 = 0 ∧
    (offsets nFf).2.2.2.1 % 16 = 0 ∧ (offsets nFf).2.2.2.2 % 16 = 0 := by
  unfold offsets
  have h1 := align16_mod (nFf * 4)
  have h2 := align16_mod (nFf / 32 * 34)

  simp only

  unfold offsets scratchBytes

  unfold offsets

  simp [weightedSum]

def better (a b : Nat × Nat) : Prop := a.1 > b.1 ∨ (a.1 = b.1 ∧ a.2 < b.2)
